audit_scope: Requirement-level implementation and evidence audit. A verified status is repository evidence, not validation of a human golf-swing mechanism.

requirements.requirement: Vary registered compatible parameters individually or simultaneously.
requirements.rationale: VariationPlan accepts one or many unique registered NoiseSpec entries and the same plan drives sampling and execution.

requirements.requirement: Support independent distributions and explicit validated grouped or correlated perturbations.
requirements.rationale: Independent normal, uniform, and triangular streams coexist with disjoint jointly normal correlation or covariance groups whose symmetry, diagonal, dimensions, finiteness, and positive semidefiniteness fail closed.

requirements.requirement: Target a whole run or a supported time or spatial window.
requirements.rationale: Issue #4756 replaces implicit locus inference with one packaged, cross-runtime execution-capability authority covering all 31 known shared and Rate extension variables. Nineteen inputs bind named whole-run or localized adapters; twelve retain explicit unsupported reasons. Python and TypeScript reject registry drift, malformed records, undeclared or forbidden loci, inexact topological joint IDs, and out-of-run windows. The standalone web mirror consumes a byte-identical governed copy without importing above its root. The two localized torque inputs execute required half-open windows at exact control joints, while spatial swing trace IDs remain distinct and no unsupported anatomical interpretation is implied.

requirements.requirement: Record schema, units, base state, distributions, groups, seed, compatibility, and provenance in every plan.
requirements.rationale: Protected PR #4669 merged the digest-cohesive version-3 execution document, and issue #4754 requalified it from protected base cff2909f1585273e10fa49165bfab8521e889da1. Current Python and TypeScript tests verify plan schema, resolved units and bases, distributions and groups, seed/RNG identity, registry and executor compatibility, source provenance, strict tamper rejection, and persistence through the supported plan, workspace, dataset, ensemble, durable, forgiveness, and regional boundaries. Historical auxiliary failures are separately adjudicated as runner provisioning contention and a subsequently repaired Upstream consumer-isolation defect; this is repository provenance verification, not human-mechanism validation.

requirements.requirement: Replay seeded plans independently of worker count and preserve one-at-a-time subset stability.
requirements.rationale: Per-spec SeedSequence streams are subset stable, chunk invariant, resumable, and tested for exact serial versus parallel results.

requirements.requirement: Fail invalid, nonfinite, incompatible, duplicate, or non-positive-semidefinite plans at the boundary.
requirements.rationale: DbC constructors reject invalid registry/mode combinations, unsafe integers, duplicate identifiers and variables, invalid loci, nonfinite values, and malformed covariance groups.

requirements.requirement: Retain sampled inputs, typed outcomes, event and impact state, shot result, and complete pre-impact traces for every trial.
requirements.rationale: Issue #4758 and PR #4762 add one immutable complete-trial record and bounded durable schema-v3 authority for every hit, no-impact, and numerical-failure trial. Records bind sampled inputs, plan/execution/configuration/source identities, frame, explicit units, stable point/joint IDs, complete swing kinematics and applied torques, event/contact state, and available impact/delivery/post-impact/launch/flight phases. Array-level shape, dtype, digest, range, strict JSON, corruption, legacy-v2 read-only, serial/chunk/resume parity, 16/64-trial scaling, and isolated installed-wheel gates pass. The exhaustive 3-source by 4-adapter matrix verifies the two qualified double-pendulum adapters and records ten other cells as explicitly unavailable without fabrication. This is model-data retention, not human or coaching validation.

requirements.requirement: Preserve no-impact as valid typed data without fabrication or silent dropping.
requirements.rationale: No-impact is an explicit outcome cohort accepted by ensemble, geometry, Morris, presentation, and export contracts.

requirements.requirement: Use stable modeled-point identifiers, explicit frames, common grids, and documented interpolation.
requirements.rationale: The versioned time-grid authority preserves stable point/frame/trial identities, is exactly equivalent on identity and subset grids for manual, double-pendulum, and triple-pendulum spatial layouts, interpolates only between adjacent valid samples, rejects extrapolation, retains missing intervals, and reports approximate impact-marker alignment error. The exhaustive 3-source by 4-adapter matrix inherits the two qualified R11.1 cells and records ten cells as explicitly unavailable. This qualifies model-output alignment, not participant validity.

requirements.requirement: Round-trip exports losslessly with migration, error handling, and reproduction provenance.
requirements.rationale: Strict schema readers and writers preserve typed rows and provenance, migrate the declared legacy shape, and reject malformed or lossy input.

requirements.requirement: Provide bounded memory, progress, cancellation, deterministic chunking, and measured performance evidence.
requirements.rationale: The authority-owned durable lifecycle uses bounded verified chunks, atomic manifests, exact resume, progress and cancellation, server-owned retention, incremental moments, and source-pinned scaling evidence.

requirements.requirement: Compute pointwise counts, centroid, covariance, principal axes, RMS radius, and confidence ellipses or ellipsoids.
requirements.rationale: The shared geometry and dispersion authorities calculate the registered statistics and bounded three-dimensional confidence meshes with explicit adequacy.

requirements.requirement: Detect and rank contiguous low-variability regions using explicit metrics, thresholds, and duration.
requirements.rationale: Selectable dispersion metrics and minimum-duration quiet-interval ranking are shared with strict plot-definition persistence and unavailable-state handling.

requirements.requirement: Separate responsiveness to input noise from absolute scatter without causal labeling.
requirements.rationale: Issue #4765 adds a versioned immutable point/time/input field that reports paired declared-scale Cartesian response and magnitude beside matched-cohort and all-eligible absolute RMS scatter. Exact counts, typed adequacy, NaN preservation, method and normalization identities, trace-resampling policy, provenance, row-oriented plot data, bounded streaming snapshots, and a 3-source by 4-adapter capability matrix are explicit. Analytical, metamorphic, nonlinear-countermodel, missingness, drift, and serial/chunk/resume tests qualify model-scenario geometry only; they do not establish causal anatomy, human validity, joint work, energy transfer, or coaching authority.

python -m pytest tests/rate_of_closure -k "response or dispersion or variation_geometry" -n 0 -q

requirements.requirement: Overlay all arcs with outcome and point grouping, reference arc, envelope, quiet zones, selection, and scalable rendering.
requirements.rationale: PyQt and React variation views render bounded arc overlays, cohorts, reference and envelope layers, quiet-zone emphasis, and selection from shared serialized plot data.

requirements.requirement: Expose frame, units, alignment, sample count, and missing-data treatment in relevant views and exports.
requirements.rationale: Strict plot data and definitions bind these fields and both presentation contracts expose adequacy and unavailable counts.

requirements.requirement: Support one-at-a-time and rank or correlation attribution for compatible scalar outputs.
requirements.rationale: The shared analysis authority computes complete-plan OAT and pairwise-finite Spearman outputs without dropping typed unavailable cohorts.

requirements.requirement: Provide a validated global method for simultaneous nonlinear or interacting inputs.
requirements.rationale: The Morris authority validates its design, clamps, elementary effects, typed unavailable outcomes, determinism, and Python to TypeScript wire parity.

requirements.requirement: Attribute parameter and optional locus to state, impact, and shot outcomes.
requirements.rationale: Issue #4783 adds one immutable paired-intervention record that binds a registered parameter and optional exact control point and half-open time window to governed state-point, impact, and shot scalars. The complete 3-source by 4-adapter authority retains two verified double-pendulum cells and ten explicit unavailabilities inherited from the qualified response-field boundary. All 17 registered target metrics, state point/time/frame selectors, source and execution identities, typed unavailable outcomes, bounded serial/chunk/resume snapshots, and precision-preserving JSON/CSV reviewer rows are explicit. Affine, sign, zero-response, nonlinear, observational-confounding, no-impact, failure, missingness, unsupported-design, identity-drift, and replay falsifiers qualify a model-scenario paired response only; they do not establish a global main effect, causal anatomy, human validity, or coaching authority.

requirements.requirement: Report interactions or uncertainty, sample adequacy, assumptions, and unavailable results honestly.
requirements.rationale: Morris, dispersion, and durable evidence contracts bind method identifiers, limitations, sample counts, adequacy, and typed unavailable states.

requirements.requirement: Inspect global or selected-input, point, phase, impact, or shot attribution without unrelated presentation recomputation.
requirements.rationale: Issue #4791 replaces name-only Morris target selection with a versioned provenance-complete identity over target class, name, unit, point, time or phase, and coordinate frame. Both surfaces enumerate exact targets and all-input or one-source views from the immutable parsed report. A selected source retains its global rank and every typed availability denominator. Same-name point and phase counterexamples, unknown and ambiguous selections, nonmutation, and an exact Python/TypeScript fixture covering state, impact, and shot targets fail closed. This is presentation of serialized model-scenario screening, not simulation, sensitivity recomputation, anatomical attribution, human validation, or coaching authority.

requirements.requirement: Expose impact and shot scatter while retaining misses as a separate typed cohort.
requirements.rationale: PyQt and React scatter views retain hit, no-impact, and failure cohorts and do not fabricate missing impact or shot coordinates.

requirements.requirement: Provide input-output scatter or matrix, distributions, attribution heatmaps, and linked trial selection.
requirements.rationale: The variation views provide scatter, distribution matrix, attribution and linked selection from the same typed dataset.

requirements.requirement: Provide equivalent PyQt and React plan, execution, analysis, persistence, and export capabilities.
requirements.rationale: The governed R14.3 interaction matrix proves equivalent PyQt and React authoring, validation, execution, progress, cancellation, joint and individual analysis policies, durable resume, result publication, persistence, export, disabled, and error behavior. Both surfaces consume Python-owned plan and result records; declared surface-only conveniences do not create separate model or evidence authority. Outputs remain model-scenario evidence, not human validation, causal anatomy, or coaching authority.

Deterministic sampling, canonical JSON/CSV/HDF5 persistence, scalar summaries, Spearman and OAT outputs, dispersion, and quiet-zone calculations remain delegated to the pinned Tools variation facade rather than copied into UpstreamDrift.

This verifies model-data parity, not participant validity.
